summary: Full end-to-end testing of Ledgerly expense tracker completed. 26/26 backend pytest cases passed (auth, categories, expenses CRUD + filters, analytics daily/weekly/monthly/yearly, profile update, OCR with real Emergent LLM call, and error paths). 16/16 frontend Playwright flows passed (login/signup rendering, demo login, dashboard bento with all stat cards & chart panels, expense create via topbar modal + verification in recent, transactions filters + edit + delete-confirm, analytics with all 4 period toggles and 4 chart panels, profile save, theme toggling on html root, logout). OCR endpoint actually invoked Gemini 3 flash successfully during test. No critical bugs found.

issues: Console emits repeated 'width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' warnings on initial mount/reload. Non-blocking (charts render correctly once container measures) but worth fixing by giving ResponsiveContainer a defined minHeight or wrapping in a mounted-guard so charts don't render before layout is measured.

action_items: (Optional) Silence recharts ResponsiveContainer size warnings by ensuring the parent has an explicit height at first paint or by rendering charts only after the layout is available.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: on-shutdown handler is fine but consider using FastAPI lifespan. Non-critical.
server.py: `get_current_user` handles both cookie session_token and Bearer JWT - correctly implemented.
server.py: OCR endpoint properly requires auth (verified via test_ocr_without_auth) and lazily imports emergentintegrations to avoid startup failure.
Frontend: All interactive elements have data-testid as required by design guidelines.
Dashboard.jsx has a 30s polling interval (`setInterval(load, 30000)`) - fine, but consider AbortController to cancel in-flight requests on unmount.
server.py analytics endpoint iterates through docs multiple times for weekly bars - O(n*7). Fine for MVP but could be indexed by day-key once for better perf.
test_credentials: demo@ledgerly.app / Demo1234! (worked out of the box)
seed_data_creation: Test created & cleaned up its own expenses (TEST_UI_Cafe) and registered a unique TEST_ user for isolated CRUD assertions. One expense (~450.50 INR, food/Demo User) remained in demo account from prior seeding.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend and frontend both fully functional as per problem statement. All data-testids listed in review_request are present and working. OCR (Gemini 3 flash via EMERGENT_LLM_KEY) is live and returns a valid JSON with amount/merchant/date/currency/suggested_category. Emergent OAuth /api/auth/session correctly returns 401 for invalid session_id. Only cosmetic recharts console-warnings observed - do not affect UX. Backend tests use pytest-xdist parallelization; keep tests isolated per user.
rca of the issue: No blocking issue. Recharts warning root cause: ResponsiveContainer measures parent via ResizeObserver on mount; before first observation cycle the width/height are -1 which triggers a dev-only warning. Mitigation: pass explicit minWidth={0} on ResponsiveContainer or wrap chart render in a mounted state flag.
